name: Raven
description: Signed, scope-bounded evidence receipts for agent commerce. Fail-closed Solana token-launch evidence for AI agents. Deterministic findings from decoded on-chain bytes; ed25519-signed receipts verifiable offline against a signer key the consumer pins; explicit scope and coverage gaps declared in every receipt; refuses and issues no receipt rather than guessing. A receipt is evidence, not a decision and not an authorization: integrity, signer trust, freshness, coverage, and consumer policy stay separate and are never collapsed into one boolean.

mcp.support_note: Linked source repository and issue tracker are private (404 for external users). The published README is LEGACY documentation: it leads with the legacy POST /verify endpoint, never mentions /receipt/v1, and calls /pubkey a "live source of truth" - /pubkey is discovery/cross-check material only, never a trust pin. Do not take the primary endpoint or any trust pin from it. Not the signed-receipt verification path.
mcp.docs_note: No partner-facing documentation link is published: the npm README is legacy (leads with POST /verify, no /receipt/v1, treats /pubkey as a trust source) and the source/issue tracker is private. Use /openapi.json and the hosted /receipt/v1 route.

acp.note: Sandbox agents are not discoverable in the ACP marketplace and cannot be hired from the public registry. Use the hosted signed API (API key required).

attestation.trustBoundary: Pin signer trust through an independently authenticated customer handoff. The same-host /pubkey endpoint is discovery/cross-check only.
attestation.signatureSuite_future: future receipt versions and algorithms require a separately documented, versioned contract; plan only, not current behavior

trust_policy.no_guessing: Current receipt-v1 returns explicit signed findings/gaps or an unsigned refusal with no receipt. Legacy v2 may label unestablished evidence 'unknowable'. Neither path silently passes.
trust_policy.verdict_upgrades: Current receipt-v1 informational evidence cannot erase triggered findings or gaps. Legacy v2 informational evidence cannot upgrade its verdict toward pass.
trust_policy.engine_versioning: SOLANA_ENGINE_VERSION stamped in every deliverable; coverage expansion is segmented from verdict changes.
trust_policy.quality_ledger: Every hosted verification appends one sanitized entry to an append-only ledger for verdict-to-outcome tracking.
trust_policy.context_is_not_evidence: unless checked and included in the signed receipt

access.rate_limits: POST /receipt/v1: 15 requests/min per key. POST /verify: 10 requests/min per key, burst 4. (alpha defaults)
access.holder_beta: Per-key gated: venue-adjusted top-holder concentration (pump.fun curve and PumpSwap vaults excluded with on-chain evidence).
access.pricing_note: Hosted API keys by request (free during alpha). ACP solana_verify_token is sandbox-only: intended 0.1 USDC/job, not publicly listed and not hireable today.
access.limits: Rate-limited (/receipt/v1 15/min per key; /verify 10/min per key, burst 4); holder-beta evidence by key only.

disclaimer: Raven verifies on-chain launch state. It does not predict price and is not financial advice. Coverage gaps are listed in every response.
payment_rail: USDC through Virtuals ACP for agent-to-agent jobs (escrow, signed deliverable, on-chain settlement) — SANDBOX ONLY, not publicly listed and not hireable today. Stablecoin-native payment rail for verification services — not an investment product, no yield.

receipt_storage.schema_note: receipt-schema.json and receipt-wire-schema.json preserve the legacy v2 storage contract. Current receipt-v1 integrations store the exact receipt-v1 object plus their local verification result; use the current vector and maintained verifier for the wire contract.
receipt_storage.note: Storage is optional and adapter-based. Raven requires no storage provider. Walrus/Harbor are documented-only future options.

handoff_policy.contract_boundary: The mappings below are legacy v2/integrator policy projection. Current receipt-v1 has no verdict field; verify its findings, gaps and independent axes, then apply consumer policy.
handoff_policy.warning: do not auto-proceed; escalate or request more evidence
handoff_policy.pass_with_info_finding_with_gaps: proceed only if the caller accepts the listed coverageGaps
handoff_policy.unknowable: block; retry or fetch missing evidence
rules: when gaps remain say: not enough evidence for a full pass

current_receipt_policy.rule: Verify payloadHash, receiptId, signature, signerPublicKey trust, expected subject, rules, freshness, findings and coverageGaps separately. Then apply consumer policy. Never invent a receipt-v1 verdict or authorization.

agent_envelope.note: This envelope describes legacy/plugin policy projection. The local MCP returns unsigned developer output and is not a signed receipt-v1 deliverable. Current signed integrations use POST /receipt/v1 and preserve the exact receipt-v1 object.

primary_action.name: verify_token
primary_action.purpose: Verify supported Solana token evidence before an agent touches a token.
primary_action.note: Everything else in this manifest is policy and discovery surface around this one action. Raven stays tiny on purpose.

contact.note: Raven Attest. Security reports are private: never include private keys, seed phrases, API keys, or other credentials in an initial report.

positioning: Signed evidence receipts for agentic Solana workflows. Discovery tools find. Research tools summarize. Payment tools pay. Trading tools execute. Raven produces evidence before action — it does not decide and does not authorize.
